personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fusion
personality_one_liner: An operational, high-density command center bathed in cinematic dark tones with premium gold accents, built exclusively for RTL commerce management.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for charts, tight metrics grouping. Arabic RTL needs proper horizontal padding to avoid edge collisions. Ensure flexDirection: 'row-reverse' is respected at the root of grouped components.

do's: Use heavy tinted glass for the bottom tab bar background to allow product imagery to subtly pass underneath
Use frosted glass on the 'Live Preview' top pill and bottom sheet headers
Ensure text on glass uses onSurface and the base tint is ≥75% surface for dark mode readability
dont's: Don't blur dense data tables or charts
Don't use glass on generic list items

screens.name: Merchant Tab Bar Layout
screens.purpose: Root navigation for merchants, featuring a prominent 64px central FAB to trigger Live Preview.
screens.layout: Custom View wrapped in a glass container (absolute bottom, left 0, right 0). Height ~80pt + safe area. Use flexDirection: 'row-reverse' so array [Right2, Right1, Center, Left1, Left2] renders RTL. The FAB (64x64px, brandPrimary, pill radius, lifted shadow) sits in the center slot, slightly overlapping the top of the bar.

screens.name: Live Preview Mode
screens.purpose: Simulates customer app view but with merchant analytics overlaid.
screens.layout: Wraps the existing customer product screens. Displays a floating Glass pill at top: '🔴 وضع المعاينة' + X to close. In product detail, injects a floating '📊 إحصائيات هذا المنتج' gold CTA fixed above bottom safe area, triggering the Gorhom Bottom Sheet.

screens.name: Product Analytics Insights (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Deep dive into specific product metrics, visitor timelines, and cart abandonment actions.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'No data yet' message.

screens.layout: Full-screen-capable bottom sheet. Top section: 3x2 bento grid of KPI cards (DAU, Sessions, Cart Drops). Middle section: Monthly sales wave/line chart + visitor bar chart. Bottom section: List of abandoned cart users with an inline 'أرسل خصم' (Send 20% Off) CTA per row.

product_placeholder.alt: Luxury gold watch on a rock

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Redesign `/app/frontend/app/merchant/_layout.tsx`. Build a custom bottom tab bar. Use `flexDirection: 'row-reverse'` to handle RTL. Slots: [Tab 1, Tab 2, FAB, Tab 3, Tab 4]. The FAB is a 64x64px circular button labeled 'بث مباشر للمتجر'.

2. Build the Live Preview transition. Tapping the FAB navigates to a new `live-preview` wrapper route that renders the customer-facing stack. Show a floating absolute pill at `top: safeArea.top + 16` reading '🔴 أنت الآن في وضع المعاينة' with an exit (X) button.

3. On `/app/frontend/app/product/[id].tsx` (when in preview mode), display a floating button at the bottom: '📊 إحصائيات هذا المنتج'. Tapping this triggers a `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` containing the Product Analytics UI.

4. Analytics UI implementation: Use `react-native-svg-charts` or `victory-native` for the wave-line yearly sales chart and monthly bars. Build a 3x2 KPI grid for visitor counts, sessions, and checkout abandons.
5. Build the abandoned carts list in the bottom sheet. Each row shows the visitor name, session duration, and an 'أرسل خصم' (Send Discount) CTA.

6. Update `/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/social.tsx`. If the merchant is viewing it in preview mode, allow them to tap a 'Reply as Store' action. The reply composer should feature a gold verified badge next to the store name.
7. Backend Data Model Requirements: Create `product_views`, `product_sessions`, and `abandoned_carts` tables/collections in your DB layer. Establish foreign keys to `product_id` and `user_id`.

8. Required API Endpoints in `server.py`: `GET /api/merchant/products/{id}/analytics` (returns timeseries data and KPIs), `GET /api/merchant/products/{id}/abandoned-carts` (returns list of users), `POST /api/merchant/abandoned-carts/{id}/send-offer` (triggers push notification), and update `PUT /api/social/posts/{id}/comments/{cid}/reply` to accept a `merchant_flag` parameter.

9. MVP Scope Trade-offs: Real-time web sockets for live visitor tracking can be skipped for MVP in favor of polling or pull-to-refresh. Keep chart rendering simple (SVG lines) before adding complex D3 interactions.

10. Ensure text on top of images (like product headers) always uses the vertical gradient scrim overlay (Layer 0: Image, Layer 1: expo-linear-gradient transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse, Layer 2: Text).
